title: Pairing renewal response
description: POST /v1/pairing/renew (CORE-2 §1), body `{}`. Trades a credential in the last week of its life (from `renewable_at` in GET /v1/pairing/credential) for a new one. The credential that was presented keeps working until `previous_credential_expires_at` (24 h grace) so a lost reply costs nothing. Refusals: 401 `permission_denied` with `error.reason` for a revoked, purged, expired or unknown credential (renewal is never a way back in); 409 `credential_renewal_not_due` with `detail.expires_at` and `detail.renewable_at` before the window; 409 `plugin_credential` for the host panel's own credential.
